subject: perf(vt): carry live resource demand into new pages
result: Project live resources and carry recent page demand with bounded hints, native fitting, burst decay and byte-budget pruning.
validation: 233 library and 450 integration tests; 386 exact native layouts and 181 smoke comparisons; 28 native page-ledger and six complete-state observations; both dense reflow checks. Three timing rounds: retained links 60–77% faster, combined map+carry short links 54–73% faster than valid pre-map controls, other controls within 0.9%.
